lastCompletedStory.title: Re-home the bun user to HOST_UID/HOST_GID build-args in the worker image

nextStoryContext: US-001 is done. The Dockerfile now re-homes bun user to HOST_UID/HOST_GID via ARG + RUN (getent group guard for gid collision, usermod, groupmod, chown -R). buildDockerBuildArgv emits --build-arg HOST_UID/HOST_GID when both are provided; absent -> no token (host mode unaffected). File-size budget raised for test/supervisor/worker-container.test.ts (326->363) and src/supervisor/worker-container.ts (220->238). Check what remaining stories exist in prd.json.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed ARG must precede the RUN that uses it; default value applies when --build-arg omitted; implementation matches spec.
